job.title: Architect (Modular) / Archicad
job.description:
THE ROLE

An opportunity exists for an Architect to join a modular high end residential studio. 

You will design, coordinate and document projects from concept through to construction completion, working closely with the Practice Director and construction team across all architectural phases to ensure strong design outcomes and smooth delivery.

You will also mentor Graduates of Architecture and help guide the direction and pace of the studio as it continues to grow.

This role suits an Architect who enjoys responsibility, collaboration and being closely connected to how buildings are actually delivered.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Leading projects from concept design through to construction completion
  • Coordinating with the Practice Director, consultants and the in-house construction team
  • Producing precise, high-quality documentation and 3D modelling
  • Mentoring and managing Graduates of Architecture
  • Contributing to leadership and design direction
  • Ensuring compliance with the NCC and relevant Australian Standards
ABOUT YOU

You will bring the following skills and experience:
  • Architect with at least 5 years’ experience, predominantly in high end residential or Multi residential
  • ArchiCAD experience required 
  • Proven experience delivering projects from concept to completion
  • Strong construction knowledge, ideally with onsite experience
  • Comprehensive understanding of the NCC and Australian Standards
  • Excellent communication skills across clients, consultants and contractors
  • A collaborative mindset with the ability to also work independently
  • Solutions focused and confident navigating challenges
  • Work full time in studio for a collaborative approach
You will have good energy, strong design instincts and the confidence to step into a leadership role.

THE PERKS

This opportunity stands out because:
  • You will join an award-winning modular practice with a strong design reputation
  • You will work in a genuinely integrated design and construction environment
  • You will be part of an enthusiastic, collaborative team
  • You will enjoy a supportive environment focused on professional growth and creativity
  • Salary is negotiable based on experience and capability
HOW TO APPLY

If you are an experienced graduate / Architect or project lead looking for a new opportunity within an award-winning modular studio, get in touch with Lee for a confidential conversation.

0406 470 020 / lee@vividrecruitment.com.au

OTHER OPPORTUNITIES

Lee is working on a range of Architecture and Interior Design roles across Brisbane, Melbourne and nationally. If you are considering a move, or simply want to understand the market, feel free to reach out for a confidential chat.

job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Vivid Recruitment is partnering with a highly respected, global engineering consultancy with a strong national presence. Known for their technical excellence and client-first approach, they’ve been delivering structural and civil solutions across commercial, residential, education, and infrastructure sectors for decades.

Their Sydney office is expanding, and they’re looking for a talented Structural Engineer with 2–5 years’ experience to join their team and play a key role in the delivery of a diverse pipeline of projects.

THE ROLE

In this role, you’ll apply sound engineering principles to deliver practical, buildable, and cost-effective solutions. Working alongside senior engineers and drafters, you’ll contribute to all aspects of project delivery — from concept to construction documentation — while liaising with clients, consultants, and project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop and deliver structural designs, documentation, specifications, and reports
  • Solve complex engineering challenges using a mix of first-principles thinking and modern tools
  • Liaise with drafters to ensure the delivery of high-quality structural documentation
  • Coordinate and communicate with architects, builders, and services consultants
  • Use design software including ETABS, SpaceGass, RAM, and RAPT
  • Ensure compliance with relevant codes, quality systems, and WHS practices
  • Assist in preparing fee proposals and project bids
  • Provide support to senior engineers while steadily building your own autonomy
ABOUT YOU

You’re a motivated and detail-driven engineer ready to step up on larger and more complex projects within a collaborative and dynamic team.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering
  • Ideally 2–5 years’ experience in a local consultancy
  • Proficiency in ETABS, SpaceGass, RAM, and RAPT
  • Member of Engineers Australia (or working towards CPEng)
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience working closely with drafters and coordinating across disciplines
  • Familiarity with local codes and Australian standards
THE PERKS
  • Strong pipeline of exciting NSW-based projects
  • Work in a global consultancy with a growing local footprint
  • Supportive, technically sharp team culture
  • Opportunities for career progression and pathway to CPEng
  • Competitive salary + training and development
  • Flexible work options
HOW TO APPLY
       
If this sounds like you, please get in touch with Nick Koop today on 0426 180 254 or nick@vividrecruitment.com.au. 
       
OTHER OPPORTUNITIES
        
Nick is looking for talented mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and fire protection engineers. If you know anyone who is looking for a role in this space, please reach out to Nick anytime!
       
ABOUT US – VIVID RECRUITMENT
          
We find and recruit the best talent for the Architecture, Design, Planning, Engineering and Construction industries. Clear and simple. It's not rocket science. There are no bells & whistles, no fancy processes. Just hard work and incredible relationships. That's what gets the job done. With over 24 years of collective experience, we know recruitment and our industries like the back of our hands. If you're looking for your next career move, we can help.
